@contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen : ∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField.{u} 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup.{uE} E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace.{u, uE} 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup.{uF} F]
  [inst_4 : NormedSpace.{u, uF} 𝕜 F] {s : Set.{uE} E} {f : E → F} {n : WithTop.{0} ℕ∞},
  IsOpen.{uE} s →
    (ContDiffOn.{u, uE, uF} 𝕜 (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1) f s ↔
      DifferentiableOn.{u, uE, uF} 𝕜 f s ∧
        (Eq.{1} n Top.top.{0} → AnalyticOn.{u, uE, uF} 𝕜 f s) ∧
          ContDiffOn.{u, uE, max uF uE} 𝕜 n (fderiv.{u, uE, uF} 𝕜 f) s)
